limitations: The REST snapshot is mutable and not pinned to a block hash.
The runtime identity was independently captured from the same testnet deployment.
The fixture proves bytes32 selection and positive 0.01 server-side price aggregation.
Server notionals are retained without assuming an exact unrounded price-times-quantity invariant.
Aggregation can overlap bid and ask price buckets, so the adapter does not invent an uncrossed-book invariant.
The snapshot is not converted into a framework Spot order book or treated as full exchange depth.
